field_name_limitation: vm_steps_lower_bound and vm_steps_upper_exclusive are not rigorous VM-instruction bounds. They are the accumulated progress-handler counter and that counter plus 1000.
reason: SQLite documents N as an approximate instruction interval and allows callbacks during query preparation. Interpret these as nominal progress units, not exact instruction counts or timing.
prospective_correction: measure_query_work.py uses progress_callbacks and nominal_progress_units and records SQLite version; v1 also measures the authored reference solver.
